accepted.claim: PASSED means every substantive finding on the trail has a resolution; no independent pass stood clean on the FINAL tree — the last independent passes saw 69adda5d, and the three walks plus the in-context confirm are the only reads of the tree that ships.
accepted.why: This is the cadence's designed shape (rc07 recorded the same distinction) — the confirm read the walks' additions line by line and executed them, and every edit after the pair was a sentence, a loop bound, a regex predicate or a fixture, each with an executed test; buying a third independent pass would be effort targeted, not recorded (R-crc-11h).

accepted.claim: The list-item boundary rule is a CommonMark APPROXIMATION: an H3+ heading, or a post-blank unindented non-item line, ends the entry; a lazy continuation (no blank line) still belongs, so a column-zero slot written as a lazy continuation attributes to the preceding entry.
accepted.why: Measured before landing: zero column-zero slot lines exist in any explore.md on the record, so no existing attribution changed; the lazy-continuation attribution is what the owning requirement's 'lazy-continuation line qualifies' sentence asks for; a full block parser is Q-crc-15's shape and out of this stage's ceiling.

accepted.claim: A Domain-table row is detected only by a leading pipe (up to three spaces of indent); a GFM row written without a leading pipe is prose to the parser, and a `## Mechanism` entry whose table uses that form judges malformed-entry.
accepted.why: The grammar's own fence writes every row pipe-led and the two exemplars follow it; within a row, padding and the trailing pipe are GFM-optional and accepted. The bound is stated in the fixture test rather than hidden.

accepted.claim: The 'until the maturity-signal stage lands' clauses in orbit-conventions' concluded-outcome requirement and in the explore body's KNOWN paragraph are now history, not falsehood, and survive this archive.
accepted.why: Declared in design.md Risks before apply: retiring them is a further capability and belongs to the retirement-class sweep rc13a deferred its five-section titles to; both blind-pair halves read the declaration and did not re-find it.

accepted.claim: `re_entry` is a first-wins RECOVERY over a file that breaks the exactly-one-live-slot authoring rule, with a stderr note per further carrier; the reader never withholds on the violation.
accepted.why: The decoder reports and never rules (R-crc-13); the authoring obligation stays stated once in orbit-conventions and the delta, design and exploration were reconciled to say which is which at the fresh half's finding.
